question: Which specific faculties are to be named when reciting the senses of the goddess?
premises: The senses are to be spoken by word.
The faculties listed are speech, mind, eye, nose, ear, and skin.
inference: One should verbally name speech, mind, eye, nose, ear, and skin as the senses.
plain_english: One should say by word: speech, mind, eye, nose, ear, and skin.
